newsitem.title: USA: Lawyers Title restructures investment plan.
newsitem.headline: Lawyers Title restructures investment plan.

text.p: Lawyers Title Corp said Friday it changed its investment strategy for the investment portfolios of its title insurance subsidiaries, shifting away from investments in equity securities and into fixed-income securities.

This shift, the company said, which is expected to be completed during the current quarter ending December 31, and will involve the sale of about $60 million in equity securities, is expected to result in one-time after-tax capital gains of about $10.5 million, or $1.18 per share, for the fourth quarter of 1996.
Proceeds of the sale of the equity securities will be reinvested in fixed-income securities, the company said.
